A '''Heat particle detector''' was a measuring device.

==Characteristics==
This device could be used to track the heat emitted from various objects and biological sources on a molecular level.

==History==
It was issued to [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]] units, one of whom used it to track [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] from [[Docking Bay 31]] inside [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]].
